title: Absolute quasi-separatedness of an algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], with point topology [def-a1-space-point-topology]. Define absolute quasi-separatedness by the affine-test criterion: for every pair of affine $S$-schemes $U,V$ and morphisms $h_U\to X$, $h_V\to X$, the sheaf fibre product $h_U\times_X h_V$ is quasi-compact on its point space. By Stacks Tag 0AHR this is equivalent to quasi-compactness of the absolute diagonal over $\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$.
